A's spectrum statistic DOES carry real predictive signal about search across real substrates -- my risky clause was written so I could lose it, and I lost it.
the_actual_shape: On the NINE REAL-substrate cells both families reach rho ~0.6 (q4 0.600, q10 0.650) and neither reaches 0.70. Across the FULL arena including the three designed controls both collapse (q10 0.20 / -0.01). The controls are what break them, and they are legitimate landscapes. Prospective geometry-based qualification therefore works only under an assumption that the substrate is not geometrically deceptive -- and nothing in the geometry tells you whether it is.

E5 says CIRCUIT|M-UNIFORM improves 0.339 against CIRCUIT|M-OPONLY 0.193 -- the SAME substrate, a 1.76x search difference, from an operator that barely moved the band. Geometry-dominance and search-dominance are different questions with different answers.
neutral_drift: Allowing neutral moves improved search on EVERY real substrate: CIRCUIT 0.339->0.371, BYTEVM 0.173->0.228 (+32%), DNF 0.503->0.570, RELAX[2.0] 0.277->0.313.
